import { gql } from '@apollo/client';

export const GET_ALL_APPOINTMENTS = gql`
  query GetAllAppointments {
    appointments {
      id
      firstName
      lastName
      email
      phone
      service
      appointmentDate
      status
      notes
      documentSigned
      envelopeId
      documentUrl
      createdAt
      updatedAt
    }
  }
`;

export const GET_APPOINTMENT = gql`
  query GetAppointment($id: ID!) {
    appointment(id: $id) {
      id
      firstName
      lastName
      email
      phone
      service
      appointmentDate
      status
      notes
      documentSigned
      envelopeId
      documentUrl
      createdAt
      updatedAt
    }
  }
`;
